title: Length of a virtual word
statement: Let a nonempty finite list of segments be given. The length of the virtual word formed by rendering the segments in order and placing the separator $01$ between consecutive segments equals the sum of the rendered lengths of all segments except the last, plus two for each such separator, plus the rendered length of the last segment.
hypotheses_covered: the list of segments is nonempty
